prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Meridian Regional ATFM+A-CDM. Airports: Meridian International, Harbor East, North Valley, Lakeside Regional, Southport. Modes: Normal Operations (regular refresh), Adverse Weather, Capacity Reduction State, Recovery Phase (Adverse/Recovery: shorter cycles approved by Copperfin), Contingency Fallback State, Slot Compliance State. System: Regional Flow Platform alias Cedarbell (coordination; shares context each cycle; creates initial Target Off Block Time proposal from flight intent, stand readiness, turnaround, capacity). Parts: Demand Prediction Service alias Marlinstone (refreshes stand demand; flags TOBTs causing runway/sector imbalance); Capacity Assessment Module (CAM); Slot Allocation Engine alias Blueharbor (matches demand to CAM; inputs Flight Intent Message, Airport Capacity Plan, Airport Acceptance Rate, runway meters, sector loading; GDP derives Calculated Takeoff Time first; priority emergency/national > scheduled per Business Rules Registry fairness > GA; no unlogged excessive delay; preferences advisory; unready aircraft resequenced; recalculates after apron constraints); Airport CDM Portal alias Foxglove; Arrival Regulation Console (arrival opportunities: capacity source, start time, delay); Departure Metering Service (departure opportunities+CTT to Tower Sequence Manager); Ramp Movement Board; Contingency Operations Console (keeps last valid allocation, manual amendments, marks Slot Compliance provisional); Weather Ingest Gateway alias Orchard (→CAM); Flight Data Exchange; Airline Interface Adapter; Audit Event Ledger (all allocation runs, timestamped by Time Synchronization Service); Performance Analytics Warehouse (post-event equity/exemption analysis); Business Rules Registry; Collaborative Decision Log; Identity Access Service; Alert Distribution Hub; Digital Briefing Room; sensors, Sector Load Monitor, Gate Conflict Detector, Handling Resource Planner, Common Situation Display. Actors: Regional Flow Manager alias Copperfin; Airline Operations Coordinator alias Saffron (Flight Intent Message, TOBT, delay slip exemption requests); Slot Coordinator (runs allocation; logs exemption decisions: rule, approver, consequence); Airport Duty Manager (Capacity Plan); Tower Supervisor alias Brindle (may reject departure opportunities); Ramp Control Lead alias Quartzline; Meteorology Briefing Officer (Storm Cell Snapshot); Data Governance Steward (versions exemption categories/priority codes/fairness metrics before live use); Ground Handling Dispatcher; System Support Engineer. Exemptions judged on safety, network, passenger, crew legality, alternatives. Flow: Flight Intent Message→Airline Interface Adapter→Flight Data Exchange→Marlinstone.

New part:
S252: The Capacity Assessment Module applies the active Airport Capacity Plan and Airport Acceptance Rate to determine whether the proposed demand pattern remains operationally feasible.
S253: The Slot Allocation Engine derives the Calculated Takeoff Time by combining runway metering constraints, departure fix loading, and applicable Ground Delay Program rules.
S254: The Tower Sequence Manager maintains the tactical runway sequence expectation and highlights cases where the Calculated Takeoff Time is inconsistent with the local departure order.
S255: The Ramp Movement Board maintains milestone timestamps for stand readiness, boarding completion, doors closed, start approval readiness, taxi start, and other locally configured departure events.
S256: The Time Synchronization Service provides the reference clock for all target time calculations so that negotiation records and operational timestamps can be compared without local clock ambiguity.
S257: For voice coordination, Halcyon is the operational call sign used by the Slot Coordinator during daily target time conferences.
S258: The Slot Coordinator reviews proposed Calculated Takeoff Time values against network constraints and requests adjustment when the allocation would create avoidable delay or unfair sequencing.
S259: The Airline Operations Coordinator reviews the proposed Target Off Block Time against aircraft readiness, crew availability, passenger connection risk, and operator recovery priorities.
S260: Saffron shall confirm any operator-requested Target Off Block Time revision in the Airport CDM Portal before the freeze horizon expires.
S261: The Ground Handling Dispatcher updates handling milestones when service completion forecasts change, and those updates are treated as negotiation inputs until the freeze point is reached.
S262: The Ramp Control Lead assesses whether the proposed off-block pattern is compatible with apron access, stand conflicts, and local movement restrictions.
S263: The Tower Supervisor may challenge a proposed Calculated Takeoff Time when runway configuration, wake spacing, or local sequencing conditions make the value operationally unsuitable.
S264: The Airport CDM Portal presents each proposed value with its confidence status, last update time, and the reason code assigned by the proposing function or authorized user.
S265: The Common Situation Display shows the current agreed target set so that operational participants can see whether a flight is proposed, under negotiation, frozen, or exempted from compliance monitoring.
S266: Negotiation remains collaborative while the value is outside the freeze horizon, and each accepted amendment replaces the prior value as the current shared plan.
S267: The Collaborative Decision Log records each challenge, counterproposal, acceptance, rejection, and reason code associated with the Target Off Block Time and Calculated Takeoff Time.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
